glossary.title: Aviation glossary
glossary.subtitle: The key acronyms and regulatory terms of Part-147 aircraft maintenance training.
glossary.defPart147: EASA regulation governing aircraft maintenance training organisations (Part-66 basic training and type ratings).
glossary.defPart66: Aircraft maintenance licence (categories A, B1, B2, B3, C) defining staff certification privileges.
glossary.defPart145: EASA approval for maintenance organisations (MRO) authorised to perform aircraft maintenance.
glossary.defHumanFactors: Human Factors: the study of elements influencing human performance in maintenance (the "Dirty Dozen").
glossary.defEwis: Electrical Wiring Interconnection Systems — aircraft electrical wiring; training required under AMC 20-22.
glossary.defFtsCdccl: Fuel Tank Safety / Critical Design Configuration Control Limitations — fuel tank safety.
glossary.defSms: Safety Management System — safety management framework (policy, risk management, assurance, promotion).
glossary.defTypeRating: Type rating: theoretical and practical training on a specific aircraft model (e.g. A320, B737).
glossary.defMro: Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul — aircraft maintenance, repair and overhaul company.
glossary.defEasa: European Union Aviation Safety Agency — the European aviation safety authority.
glossary.defDgac: Direction Générale de l'Aviation Civile — the French civil aviation authority.
glossary.defOsac: Organisme pour la Sécurité de l'Aviation Civile — the delegated oversight body in France.
glossary.defQualiopi: French quality certification for training organisations, required to access public and pooled funding.
glossary.defCpf: Compte Personnel de Formation — the French scheme for funding vocational training.
glossary.defRecurrence: Requirement to periodically renew certain training courses (e.g. HF, FTS, EWIS) to maintain compliance.
glossary.defScormXapi: E-learning content interoperability standards enabling tracking of time spent, modules and scores.
